description: This PHP class file defines the 'InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand' class, which extends 'InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand' and provides functionality for configuring and installing an application on an existing database within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for gathering database connection info from the user and validating database state before proceeding.

classes.name: InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class facilitating installation procedures on an existing database, including user input collection and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this command, 'install:on-existing-database'.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Interactively gathers database connection details from the user, validates the database state, and stores configuration info.
